mechanism.claim: When average BTC execution size rises simultaneously in the USDC and FDUSD spot books while falling in dominant USDT, larger risk transfer is rotating into alternative dollar books. If alternative-book aggressive flows agree during high BTC variation, follow that direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed-block BTCUSDC and BTCFDUSD signed taker flow
mechanism.why_distinct: CQSTL compares signed flow per execution levels and requires USDT magnitude subordination. SQCBI uses trade-count shares and entropy. HVCQTR uses unsigned average BTC ticket-size changes across consecutive blocks as the event and uses flow only for direction; no prior event or control is reused.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: cross-quote ticket-size rotation at three eight-hour boundaries is absent from Gross9

features.source: hash-bound official Binance Spot hourly panel for BTCUSDT, BTCUSDC and BTCFDUSD
features.blocks: current and immediately prior exact consecutive eight-hour UTC blocks ending at 00:00,08:00,16:00
features.block_valid: eight exact source_complete rows per symbol, finite nonnegative base volume, integer aggregate trade_count>=80, positive aggregate base volume; no imputation
features.average_ticket: aggregate base_volume_btc/aggregate trade_count independently per book
features.rotation: USDC and FDUSD ticket changes strict positive while USDT ticket change strict negative
features.alternative_flow_consensus: current-block USDC and FDUSD signed_taker_flow_btc sums strict nonzero and same sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over 24 hours ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 prior valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_variation_gate: ticket rotation plus alternative flow consensus without BTC variation rank
definitions.no_ticket_rotation: high variation and alternative flow consensus at every valid block
definitions.usdt_ticket_expansion: high variation, all three ticket changes strict positive, side alternative consensus
definitions.one_block_stale_ticket_rotation: primary rotation boolean shifted one exact block while current alternative flow sets side

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-quote unsigned ticket-size rotation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbols, block, ticket, rotation, flow side, variation, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
